blocks.text: El Tatio Geysers and Return to Santiago

provenance.rationale: The title joins the documented Tatio Geysers visit and the same-day onward transfer and flight to Santiago.

blocks.text:
Early departure for the Tatio Geysers, one of the world’s largest geothermal fields. The excursion takes half a day.

At sunrise, the cold air makes the columns of steam particularly striking against the blue sky and the Andes. Morning temperatures can drop to −2°C, so a warming breakfast is served here.

After breakfast, enjoy a dip in a small natural hot-spring pool.

On the return journey, look out for vicuñas and vizcachas. The route also passes through Machuca, a village with the Church of San Santiago and a small wetland pond inhabited by flamingos and other birds.

In Machuca, you can try local specialities such as empanadas, sopaipillas and llama meat.

Continue by transfer to Calama for your flight to Santiago and check in at your hotel.

**Included:** Entrance fee to the Tatio Geysers.
